title: LongMemEval
domain: Long-term chat memory: questions over timestamped chat histories.
good_to_know: The S, M and oracle files run cleaned, and S and M also as first released. The paper's numbers come from the files as first released.
An M file is 2.7 GB and needs about 5.5 GB of free disk. STANDARD_DATA_DIR moves the datasets to a disk with room.
Reading is chain-of-note by default, or direct. Separate notes work with Original memory only.
Original memory offers the paper's Contriever and Stella retrievers and needs a CUDA GPU. Stella requires at least 12000 MiB of GPU memory; the run checks it before starting.
upstream_limitations: Scores compare with the paper only with its reader, GPT-4o or GPT-4o-mini, and its judge, GPT-4o.
A reader you choose must take about 126,200 tokens. The history is not cut to fit, so a longer recall fails at the model.
An empty reply from the reader fails the question.
Three combinations fail as published: merge expansion with a full-history retriever, user-only with flat-bm25-turn, and separate notes with chain-of-note reading and nl history.
The judge, a model, rejects about one right answer in twenty, and passes an empty answer now and then.
Time-aware query expansion fails as published.
limitations: The GTE retriever, time-aware query expansion and open-weight readers are not offered. Index expansion uses the authors' released caches with flat retrievers at the matching session or turn granularity.
